name: zinput_keyboard_shutdown_device
description: zInput::Keyboard_ShutdownDevice releases the keyboard DirectInput device and frees the keyboard event buffer while preserving the original global pointer behavior.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; no VC target currently covers zInput::Keyboard_ShutdownDevice.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46f420 validates a null keyboard-device skip path, then for a non-null device calls the DirectInput device vtable Unacquire slot 0x20 followed by Release slot 0x08, loads g_zInput_KbdEventBuffer, calls imported free when it is non-null, and returns zero.
Binary Ninja assembly also validates that g_zInput_KbdDevice and g_zInput_KbdEventBuffer are not cleared by this function; higher-level shutdown code handles later global state reset.

Native smoke zinput_keyboard_shutdown_device_smoke verifies the null-device/null-buffer path returns zero without provider calls, then uses a fake DirectInput device and allocated event buffer to verify one Unacquire call, one Release call, zero return, and preservation of both global pointers after the function returns.
The full native CTest preset passes with the focused smoke registered in the suite.
